newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Heavy shooting erupts in Sierra Leone capital.
newsitem.headline: Heavy shooting erupts in Sierra Leone capital.

text.p: Heavy shooting erupted in the Sierra Leone capital Freetown on Sunday from the direction of state house and military headquarters, witnesses said.
"There is still heavy fighting going on now. They're using mortars and shells. The whole city is vibrating with explosions," a Reuters correspondent in the city centre said.
The shooting started at around 5.00 a.m (0500 GMT) and was continuing more than three hours later.

The immediate cause of the fighting was not clear but some witnesses said it appeared to be between rival factions of President Ahmad Tejan Kabbah's government. Kabbah was reported to be in the capital but his fate was not known.
Witnesses said about 20 heavily armed soldiers broke into the Pademba road central prison in the capital and freed more than 600 inmates.
